# ssp_alarm_definition_config (Resource)

Manages the enabled state of a pre-existing, system-defined alarm definition.

Alarm definitions are created by the platform, not by this resource — there is no
`POST`/`DELETE` for `/ssp/alarms/definitions/{id}`. Use `id` to adopt an existing
definition (see `data.ssp_alarm_definitions` to discover valid IDs) and `enabled`
to control whether it can generate new alarm instances.

`Delete()` only removes this resource from Terraform state — there is no remote
call to undo, since the definition itself is not deletable.

Corresponds to `GET /ssp/alarms/definitions/{id}` and `POST /ssp/alarms/definitions/{id}`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this alarm definition can generate new alarm instances.
- `id` (String) ID of the pre-existing alarm definition to configure.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Full description of this alarm.
- `event_type` (String) Machine-readable event type that triggers this alarm.
- `feature_display_name` (String) Human-readable name of the feature this alarm belongs to.
- `feature_name` (String) System name of the feature this alarm is associated with.
- `kb_article` (String) URL to a Knowledge Base article with more detail.
- `recommended_action` (String) Guidance on how to address and resolve the alarm condition.
- `severity` (String) Severity level of this alarm (`CRITICAL`, `HIGH`, `MEDIUM`, `INFORMATIONAL`).
- `summary` (String) Brief overview of the alarm's purpose.
